constraints.expression: occupancy_level = occupancy_levels(census_end, available_beds)
constraints.description: The occupancy band is recomputed from the flow-balance census_end and the beds available that day (schema.occupancy_levels), so it always matches the counts.

constraints.description: The staffing band is recomputed from the day-shift nurses against the ward's nurse requirement (schema.staffing_levels).

constraints.expression: emergency_boarders, avg_bed_wait_hours ~ empirical marginal per ward_id x occupancy band (recomputed) (distributional transform)
constraints.description: ED boarders at midnight and the day's mean bed wait follow their empirical distribution per ward and occupancy band, the band recomputed from the final counts like the occupancy label: boarders and long waits appear on the full ward-days that have them in the reference data (no boarders on low or normal days, so WD-S03 holds there).

constraints.expression: escalation_beds_open = min(max(0, max(census_start, census_end) - bed_capacity + beds_closed) + learned extra, ward maximum)
constraints.description: Escalation beds are modelled as the cover the start and end census need above the base beds net of closed beds, plus a learned extra >= 0, so the census fits the beds available at both ends of the day (WD-H06, WD-H15, hence WD-H07) whenever that cover is within the ward's observed escalation range.

constraints.expression: ward_id in learned zero set => elective_scheduled = elective_cancelled = transfers_in = 0
constraints.description: Wards that never book electives or receive transfers in the reference data produce exact zeros (learned per ward).

constraints.expression: day_of_week in learned zero set => elective_scheduled = elective_cancelled = 0
constraints.description: Days of the week without elective lists in the reference data (Sunday) produce exact zeros (learned).

constraints.expression: elective_scheduled, elective_cancelled ~ empirical marginal per ward_id x day_of_week (distributional transform); elective_cancelled <= elective_scheduled
constraints.description: Elective lists follow the empirical distribution of their day of the week (and ward): flat Monday-Friday lists, rare Saturday lists and none on Sundays are reproduced exactly instead of the false weekday gradient a linear copula imposes along the weekday encoding; cancellations never exceed the list.

constraints.expression: beds_closed ~ empirical marginal per ward_id x staffing band (recomputed) (distributional transform)
constraints.description: Closed beds follow their empirical distribution per ward and staffing band, the band recomputed from the day-shift nurses: beds are closed mainly on short-staffed days, and zero days keep their real share instead of a smeared parametric marginal.

constraints.expression: escalation_beds_open ~ empirical marginal per ward_id (distributional transform)
constraints.description: The escalation beds opened beyond the census need (mostly zero) follow their empirical distribution per ward, so zero days keep their real share.

constraints.expression: nurses_day_shift ~ empirical marginal per ward_id x month (distributional transform)
constraints.description: Day-shift nurses follow their empirical distribution per ward and month: the winter short staffing sits in the lower tail of a few-valued roster, which neither a smooth parametric marginal nor a linear link to the month encoding reproduces.

conditional_sampling.strategy: pooled rejection (exact) + native SDV conditioning for rare conditions

constraints.expression: admission_source in learned zero set => booking_lead_days = times_rescheduled = 0
constraints.description: Emergency and transfer admissions are never booked ahead or rescheduled: exact zeros (learned per admission source).

constraints.expression: discharge_delay_hours ~ empirical marginal per delay_reason (distributional transform)
constraints.description: Delay hours follow the empirical distribution of their delay reason: exactly 0 without a reason, the reason's own range otherwise (e.g. days for a care-facility bed, hours for transport), so the reason keeps predicting the delay length.

constraints.expression: los_nights ~ empirical marginal per admission_day_of_week (distributional transform)
constraints.description: Length of stay follows the empirical distribution of its admission weekday (and ward x source): the discharge weekday is admission weekday + nights (mod 7), a modular relation a linear copula cannot learn, so without it discharges spread evenly over the week and there are too many weekend discharges.

constraints.expression: admission_hour, bed_wait_hours, discharge_hour, bed_turnaround_minutes ~ empirical marginal per ward_id x admission_source (distributional transform)
constraints.description: Admission and discharge hours, bed waits and bed turnaround follow their empirical distribution per ward x admission source: hour-of-day profiles and right-skewed waits are reproduced exactly instead of a smoothed parametric marginal.

constraints.expression: (separation_type, discharge_destination, delay_reason) in observed combinations
constraints.description: Separation type, destination and delay reason only appear in combinations seen in the reference data (transfer out <=> internal ward; reasons allowed per destination).

constraints.expression: (ward_id, admission_source) in observed combinations
constraints.description: Each ward only admits through the sources it accepts (e.g. AMU: emergencies only).

card.constraint_enforcement: Constraints inside the SDV synthesizer (groups: inequality, fixed_combinations, regime_labels, structural_zeros, capacity, conditional_marginals) enforce ordering inequalities, observed category combinations, band labels recomputed from their counts, learned structural zeros, escalation beds that cover the census and exact per-group marginals (delay hours per delay reason, elective lists per ward and weekday, ED boarders and bed waits per ward and occupancy band, closed beds per ward and staffing band, day-shift nurses per ward and month, escalation beds beyond the census need per ward, length of stay per admission weekday, hour, wait and turnaround marginals per ward x admission source) by construction; derived columns are recomputed by schema.derive (flow balance and ratios); the remaining hard-rule failures (a census beyond the ward's observed escalation range, same-day stay hours, delays longer than the stay, rebooking leads) are removed by the generator's rejection sampling with bedsynth.validation.
